conviction_note: Near non-result: the H1 is not guided, this company has held its full-year plan unrevised through every interim print for three fiscal years, no interim dividend or buyback is in its pattern, and the only directional content is an inference that Q2 condo deliveries (on schedule) and the development sales the company said start in Q2 make H1 look like a sharp recovery from the Q1 loss, which sits inside the plan the market already holds; p_up 53 on abs 2.3 gives +0.14, below the +0.3 finding sum because the Q2 timing of the development closings is inferred, not documented.
bar: Full-year FY3/2027 company plan, unchanged since 2026-04-24 and reaffirmed 2026-07-28: revenue 145,000m, OP 26,500m, ordinary 20,000m, net 14,000m, dividend 53 yen (https://f.irbank.net/pdf/20260728/140120260724599425.pdf). No H1 guide (the company states it manages annually). No IFIS consensus exists (https://kabuyoho.jp/sp/reportAnalyst?bcode=8892 shows '--'). So there is no sourced H1 bar; implicit comparison is last year's H1 OP 4,905m / ordinary 2,380m (https://kabutan.jp/stock/finance?code=8892). Finding sizes are capped small for this reason.

findings.finding: The Q1 release put the H1 load into Q2: cumulative condo deliveries scheduled 252 units by end-Q2 (49 in Q1, so ~203 in Q2 incl. Sapporo Odori The Tower 80 units, Nara 77, Nagoya Marunouchi 39) against 289 a year earlier, development sales 1.5% sold plus 25.5% of the 55.8bn FY segment plan already contracted at June-end with 'major income-property sales staged from Q2', and a portal listing shows the Sapporo tower built Aug 2026 with move-in late September, i.e. on schedule; so H1 should show a large sequential recovery from the Q1 ordinary loss (-1,017m) and may print H1 OP near or above last year's 4,905m.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Interim prints on real TDnet dates (close to next close, Yahoo bars): H1 2025-10-24 -0.10%, Q1 2026-07-28 -0.27% (despite a loss), Q3 2026-01-30 -4.11%, FY 2026-04-24 +5.63% (new guide), Q1 2025-07-25 -4.26%. Intermediate quarters with no guide change have mostly moved little.
findings.why_not_priced: The schedule is public, so the shape is partly priced; what is not is the size of the Q2 development closings, which the company has not disclosed by deal and which no analyst consensus covers (IFIS shows no estimate). If the market were pricing a strong H1 recovery the stock would not sit at PER 7.3 with a 5% yield after a -4% 20-day drift; equally if it feared a weak H1 the margin longs would not have been the ones cutting (9.15 to 5.67).

Both company documents are one source in substance.

findings.finding: ES-CON has not revised its full-year forecast at any interim print in the last three fiscal years (FY3/2024, FY3/2025, FY3/2026 plans unchanged from initial to actual in IFIS's revision history) and has filed no 業績予想の修正 since the 2026-07-28 Q1 release, so a forecast change at this H1 is unlikely; the print most likely adds no guidance news.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: The only print that moved the guide (FY 2026-04-24, new year's plan above street) rose +5.63%; interim prints with the plan held moved -0.10% and -0.27%.
findings.why_not_priced: Not a directional item; it bounds the move. Its effect is in abs_move_pct, not in the sign.

findings.finding: No interim dividend (H1 dividend 0 yen, year-end 53 yen guided under a stated progressive, never-cut policy) and no buyback or 優待 change was announced at either of the last two H1 prints (2025-10-24 and 2024-10-25 carried only the 短信 and the presentation), so shareholder returns are unlikely to move this print.
